notes: Trastuzumab/HER2 affinity library from oxpig/Tz_her2_affinity_and_beyond at revision b774c3b7633a13fb74575cd51c14893ea55ff544. Per-file retrieval URLs are pinned in the untracked retrieval record data/raw/her2_functional_20260918/source_manifest.json; each is https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oxpig/Tz_her2_affinity_and_beyond/b774c3b7633a13fb74575cd51c14893ea55ff544/<upstream_path>, and the hashes here are the same bytes. WHAT THE LABELS ARE: sorted binding bins (high / mid / low), NOT KD values; label==1 is exactly class=='high', and mid/low are lower bins, not validated nonbinders. No KD is derived from them anywhere in this repository. POPULATION: the published cleaned random_split 0.7/0.15/0.15 holds 367,042 / 78,652 / 78,652 distinct 10-mer HCDR3 cores over one fixed trastuzumab scaffold (VH ...YYC-SR-<core>-Y-WGQGTLVTVSS, fixed VL), 524,346 in total, zero exact cross-split overlap, all 20 canonical residues present at each of the ten positions in the training high bin. Class counts: train 120,504 high / 133,008 mid / 113,530 low; val 25,822 / 28,502 / 24,328; test 25,823 / 28,501 / 24,328. The realized allocation is class-proportional to within one row in every class, so prevalence (0.32831) is comparable across splits. SCOPE BOUNDARY: this is one lineage, one target and ten editable positions - a local fixed-scaffold benchmark, not de novo antibody design, and held-out ranking on random_split is interpolation over a dense local library. INDEPENDENT ASSAY: data/spr/spr_results.xlsx carries 768 measured designs. The workbook metadata declares Carterra CMDP chip SPR while the repository README abstract (line 20) says Biolayer Interferometry; The workbook is recorded as SPR; the discrepant README wording is preserved explicitly. Outcome column E is not read until a frozen selection exists. TEST CUSTODY: test.csv labels are read only through the SelectionUnlock gate in src/smallAntibodyGen/experiments/her2_data.py; the test sequence column alone is read earlier for overlap diagnostics. Aggregate integrity checks and two printed example rows per split were performed during the 2026-09-18 audit; that disclosure stands.

owner_decisions.question: What quantity, unit, and direction does the released measurement column carry?
Which released artifact defines the editable sites and their allowed residues?
Supply the raw downloads so per-file byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes can be computed and recorded.
Are the released labels quantitative affinities or sorted bins, and what does label==1 mean?
What is the license of the retrieved artifacts, and does it permit redistribution of derived splits?
Which exact release/revision of this source is authoritative for the benchmark?
On what date were the authoritative files retrieved?
Which split is authoritative, and was it produced upstream or here?
Who holds the reserved test labels, and where does the loader firewall sit?

plan_assertions.claim: The published split is named random_split and is a row-wise split of one local library; it is not a distant-family or held-out-lineage generalization test.
The 700 method designs in the independent assay workbook share the training scaffold, so exact core overlap with any published split must be excluded before the cohort is called independent.
